# Mustafa Hafeez

Mustafa joined Visokio in 2007 and is now a senior software engineer working on Omniscope, a data analytics platform. Independent developer of Travel Document Vault, an offline app for passports, visas and IDs. His writing draws on practical work with product features, automation, AI integrations and releases. He offers independent technical consultancy on reporting, integrations, automation and practical AI.

## Published articles
- [When a missing day looks like zero](https://mustafahafeez.com/blog/when-a-missing-day-looks-like-zero/index.html.md): One day of website traffic was missing from my daily briefing. Here’s how I checked the recovery and how to tell a reported zero from a gap in your own data.
- [Why I use Google Secret Manager for reporting](https://mustafahafeez.com/blog/reporting-credentials-google-secret-manager/index.html.md): Credential access tells you a job can connect. It does not tell you the numbers in the report are right.
- [How I’m using Omniscope and AI for daily app analytics](https://mustafahafeez.com/blog/ai-reporting-pipeline/index.html.md): My Omniscope briefing had one chart for Google search clicks and another for taps on app store links. Both read the same data, so I couldn’t compare the two measures. Here’s how we traced each chart to its source and checked the saved report.
- [How I’m building verification into AI-assisted development](https://mustafahafeez.com/blog/verification-ai-assisted-development/index.html.md): How I use a Definition of Done to verify AI-assisted development, choose test data that exposes mistakes and record which checks ran.
- [Your AI agent’s instructions grew while you weren’t looking](https://mustafahafeez.com/blog/ai-agent-context-instructions/index.html.md): An instruction audit found ignored scope metadata, stale guidance and safeguards lost during trimming. Five checks for reviewing what your agent reads.
- [When an AI agent cannot run your tests](https://mustafahafeez.com/blog/tests-inside-agent-sandbox/index.html.md): How I adapted tooling tests for a restricted environment, and why some checks still needed the real machine.
- [Before I accept an AI agent’s changes](https://mustafahafeez.com/blog/reviewing-ai-agent-work/index.html.md): Checking what my website build would publish, and how I tested an AI agent’s release check.
